answer: The checker taps his moulds with the knuckle, and the tap must ring true or the tin has a dent. Chandler suet candle packer pour writ is the tapping: a writ suet candle packers sign after packing room audits. The tide is the first tap, made at the bench; the jetty is the last, made before the moulds are filled, and the thread is the bench itself, dented by a thousand taps. A cheat must tap 53 false moulds and fill 53 false benches.
